_README: Per-tool commands used by the docker-vs-native benchmark harness (obj1_bench.py). {NATIVE_OUT}/{DOCKER_OUT}/{NATIVE_ENV} are filled in at run time. Peak RAM = GNU `time -v` MaxRSS, the same instrument for native and docker. MCMC tools run genome-wide (all chromosomes) with identical reduced-iteration settings in both modes, so the docker/native ratio and peak RAM stay comparable.
